instruction: Contrast the features and specifications of the iPhone 15 Plus, iPhone 14 Plus, and iPhone 13 Plus.

metadata.explanation: Task requires comparing iPhone 15 Plus with iPhone 14 Plus and iPhone 13 Plus. The evaluator uses get_active_tab_url_parse to extract the modelList query parameter from the Apple compare URL and verifies it contains the three expected iPhone models. No custom functions needed as we reuse existing evaluator framework.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirements
Getter (get_active_tab_url_parse) extracts the modelList query parameter from the active tab URL and splits it into a list, which matches the expected data format
Metric (check_direct_json_object) properly compares the extracted modelList against the expected three iPhone models (iphone-15-plus, iphone-14-plus, iphone-13-plus)
The ignore_list_order flag correctly allows any order of the three models in the URL
Complete coverage: all three iPhone models specified in the instruction are verified

Data flow is semantically correct: instruction -> user navigates to Apple compare page -> URL contains modelList parameter -> getter extracts and splits it -> metric verifies all three models are present
The evaluator will correctly distinguish between success (all 3 models present) and failure (missing models, wrong models, or incorrect count)
